faq.q: What is an AI unboxing video?
faq.a: A short ad of a parcel opening onto your product. AIVideosUGC writes the script, matches a presenter and a voice, and cuts it from a photo or a product link. Name the main item first, then the pieces that come with it. You do not film it.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing video with AI?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product link. You do not need a photo of the box: describe the mailer and the tissue. The tool writes the script and matches a presenter and a voice. Then download, or publish to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: Which page should I use for an unboxing ad?
faq.a: Use this page when the clip should show the parcel opening onto the item you sell. For a general product ad, start from [AI UGC video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: Is there a free unboxing video?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 15-second open uses 60 credits. The download has no watermark, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Commercial use is included and the file has no watermark. The presenter is generated, not a buyer, so do not post the clip as a customer review.

Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, and 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels. Check words printed on the box, and fix a letter in the editor if it looks wrong. You can publish to TikTok or Meta from that same editor.

faq.q: Can I make opens for a whole catalog?
faq.a: Yes. Run a batch from the product photos or links in the catalog, instead of one clip at a time. Each clip shows its credit cost before it starts. A developer can send that batch through the API.

faq.q: Will an AI open replace a filmed one?
faq.a: Use the AI open to try more versions, with a new presenter, voice, or language. Keep a filmed open when you want a real customer on camera. The generated person is not a buyer.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI unboxing ad?
faq.a: Do not present the clip as a customer review. Before you spend, read the current TikTok or Meta rule and add any label it asks for.

definition.title: What Is an AI Unboxing Video?
paras: An AI unboxing video is a short ad of a parcel opening onto your product. AIVideosUGC writes the script, matches a presenter and an AI voice, and cuts the clip from a photo or a product link. Nothing is filmed.

Captions and a track from the music library go on in the editor. You can switch language, run a batch for the catalog, or send a job through the API. Each clip can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, with commercial use and no watermark.

more_sections.lead: Seven kinds of open. None of these cards is a customer review.

items.d: A skincare shop shows the jar coming out of tissue, with a short spoken line about what is in the box.
A beauty shop opens the set, main item first, then the extras, with captions on the clip.
An apparel shop lifts the garment out of the mailer so the shape is clear in the first second.
A food brand opens the carton and ends on the bottle or the bag you sell.
An electronics shop lays the device and the cable in one frame as the box opens.
A fitness shop opens the parcel onto the band or the bottle, with a presenter from the actor library.
A home shop shows the box, the tissue, and the item on a table, then publishes the cut to TikTok or Meta.
